instruction: We represent Drabir AgriAerial Holdings, Inc., the buyer under its asset purchase agreement with Troudaind Field Robotics, LLC, and the maker of the Seller Note. Please review all eight documents in the folder and send me a memo listing each issue you find. For each one, give the document and section where it appears, explain why it matters to Drabir, and recommend a fix. Keep it practical, since we'll use it to advise the client.

rubric.text: The response identifies that Side Letter Section 2 requires Buyer to indemnify Seller, without cap or basket, for Seller's own pre-closing Harvest Drift Trial liabilities, so Buyer bears uncapped liability for Seller's conduct. It locates the issue in the Side Letter (Section 2), explains why this matters to the client, and recommends a fix.
hints: shall not be subject to the Cap

rubric.text: The response identifies that the IP Assignment Agreement defines 'Business' as AgriSpray drone hardware only, so the FieldPath flight-planning software and CanopyLens analytics IP would not be conveyed to Buyer. It locates the issue in IP Assignment Agreement Section 1.1 or APA Section 11.9, explains why this matters to the client, and recommends a fix.

The response identifies that Buyer's ten-Business-Day termination window after the September 21, 2026 Schedule Supplement expired (around October 5, 2026) before the October 19, 2026 board consent objected, so the FAA Part 137 investigation is deemed cured and Buyer has lost its termination and indemnity rights for it. It locates the issue in APA Section 6.9(b) or Schedule Supplement No. 1, explains why this matters to the client, and recommends a fix.

The response identifies that the asset sale requires Kestrelmark's prior written consent under the Exclusive Dealer Agreement, but that consent is not a condition to Buyer's obligation to close. It locates the issue in Disclosure Schedule 3.9(a)(iv) or APA Section 7.2(d), explains why this matters to the client, and recommends a fix.
The response states that the Purchase Price is $41,500,000.
The response is a memo that presents each issue separately and, for each issue, gives the document and section, explains why it matters to Drabir, and recommends a fix.
The response claims that Buyer's Section 6.9(b) window to terminate over Schedule Supplement No. 1 is still open.
The response claims that APA Section 7.2(d) makes Kestrelmark's consent a condition to Buyer's obligation to close.
hints: Kestrelmark consent is a closing condition
